name: CNMC Goldmine Holdings Limited
summary: CNMC Goldmine Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration and mining of gold deposits in Malaysia. The company also explores for silver, lead, and zinc deposits. Its flagship project is the Sokor Gold Field project, which covers an area of 2,370 acres located in Tanah Merah, Kelantan. The company also provides mineral exploration, drilling, and underground mining services, as well as non-mining related services. CNMC Goldmine Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Singapore.
